# pocketid_user_passkeys (Data Source)

Lists the passkeys a Pocket-ID user has registered, read-only. For example, a precondition can require an administrator to have at least two. It reports each passkey's identifier, name, registration time and whether it is backed up or synced, and no credential material: not the credential ID, not the public key. Pocket ID records no time of last use, so none is reported. There is no resource to create or delete passkeys: deleting one can lock a user out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pocketid_user" "owner" {
  username = "owner"
}

data "pocketid_user_passkeys" "owner" {
  user_id = data.pocketid_user.owner.id
}

# Fail the plan when the owner could be locked out by losing one device.
check "owner_has_two_passkeys" {
  assert {
    condition     = length(data.pocketid_user_passkeys.owner.passkeys) >= 2
    error_message = "The owner has fewer than two passkeys registered."
  }
}

# Passkeys that sync (for example through a platform keychain or a password
# manager) survive the loss of one device.
output "owner_synced_passkeys" {
  value = [
    for passkey in data.pocketid_user_passkeys.owner.passkeys : passkey.name
    if passkey.backup_state
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user (a UUID).

### Read-Only

- `passkeys` (Attributes List) The user's passkeys, oldest first. Empty when the user has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--passkeys))

<a id="nestedatt--passkeys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `passkeys`

Read-Only:

- `aaguid` (String) The identifier of the authenticator model. Null when the authenticator reported none, and on Pocket ID 2.14, which does not report it.
- `backup_eligible` (Boolean) Whether the authenticator allows the passkey to be backed up or synced to other devices.
- `backup_state` (Boolean) Whether the passkey is currently backed up or synced (a synced passkey, such as one in a platform keychain or password manager).
- `created_at` (String) When the passkey was registered, in RFC3339 format.
- `id` (String) Pocket ID's identifier of the passkey.
- `name` (String) The name the user gave the passkey.
- `transports` (Set of String) The transports the authenticator reported, such as `internal`, `usb` or `hybrid`. Empty when it reported none.
